verdict.rationale: Bolna is a hosted voice AI platform that handles call recordings and transcripts, so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out, no no-training policy, and no data-usage commitment. Self-hosting (bolna-docs-9), Indian data residency (bolna-docs-20) and bring-your-own-keys are related deployment and data controls, not a training-prevention capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
